description: ol-duplicate-definition (issue #113): two `define f ... end` blocks declare the same procedure name. The first stays clean -- a name is only "already defined" relative to an earlier occurrence -- so only the second raises. The code carries BOTH spans -- `source_span` at the later declaration (line 4) and `params.original_span` at the earlier one (line 1) -- which is required identity, not message decoration: error-model.md:143-146 says an implementation "MUST supply it rather than folding the earlier location into the message text", so an editor can offer *jump to the first definition* and so the code works unchanged when the earlier declaration arrives from an imported module.
